description: Bootable MS-DOS 2.0 360K FAT12 disk: IO.SYS (assembled from bw-board dos/iosys.asm) + Microsoft MSDOS.SYS + COMMAND.COM. No user program; the code tab injects PROG.COM at runtime (bw-board/dos-fat-inject).
licence: MIT — Microsoft MS-DOS 2.0 (github.com/microsoft/MS-DOS v2.0/bin) + bw-board IO.SYS/boot sector; redistributable
reproduce: npm run fetch:free-dos into MSDOS_BIN_DIR, then bw-board scripts/build-dos-image.mjs (no extra program)
